## Instalações Python a partir do R

| comando | descrição |
| ------- | --------- |
| py_available() | checa se python está instalado no sistema |
| install_python()| instala python |
| install_miniconda() |    Install Miniconda |
| py_numpy_available() | checa se numpy está disponível |
| py_module_available("módulo") | Check if a Python module is available on this system.|
| py_install()| Install Python packages |
| py_list_packages() |    List installed Python packages |
| uv_run_tool()|    uv run tool |

## Utilizando o UV a partir do R
<!-- {visibility="hidden"}  -->

```{r }
#| eval: false
reticulate::use_virtualenv("uv_nlp_314")
reticulate::uv_run_tool("pip list")
reticulate::uv_run_tool("ruff", "--help")
# reticulate::uv_run_tool("uv pip install gliner2")

system2("uv", args = "pip list", stdout = TRUE)
```

## Ex. Chamando funções métodos Python como funções R
<!-- {visibility="hidden"} -->
Exemplo, pacote [GliNER2](https://github.com/fastino-ai/GLiNER2) 
E no R, [gliNERR](https://github.com/SoaresAlisson/gliNERR)

Diretamente no Python
```{python py:gliner2}
#| eval: false
from gliner2 import GLiNER2 
model = "fastino/gliner2-large-v1"
extractor = GLiNER2.from_pretrained("fastino/gliner2-large-v1")

import pickle 
# file_name = "/home/alisson/Documentos/Programação/R/meus_pacotes/gliNERR/extractor_fastino_gliner2-large-v1"
# pickle.loads(extractor_name)

dir(extractor)
dir(extractor.extract_entities)

text = "O grupo R Brasil no Telegram agora transmite vídeos"
result = extractor.extract_entities(text, ["name"])
print(result)
```
## Chamando funções métodos Python como funções R 
Opção 2: quase "nativo"
Transformando função python em função R

```{r r.gliner}
#| eval: false 
library(reticulate)
reticulate::use_virtualenv("uv_nlp_314")
reticulate::py_config()$python
## [1] "/home/alisson/.virtualenvs/uv_nlp_314/bin/python"
gliner2 <- reticulate::import("gliner2", convert = FALSE)
## py_help(gliner2)
class(gliner2) 
##  "python.builtin.module" "python.builtin.object"
```
---

```{r r.gliner 2}
#| eval: false 
# carregando o modelo
model <-  "fastino/gliner2-large-v1"
# extractor <- gliner2$GLiNER2$from_pretrained(model)
extractor_name <- "~/Documentos/Programação/R/meus_pacotes/gliNERR/extractor_fastino_gliner2-large-v1"
extractor <- reticulate::py_load_object(extractor_name)
class(extractor)
## [1] "gliner2.inference.engine.GLiNER2"                
## [2] "gliner2.model.Extractor"                         
## [3] "transformers.modeling_utils.PreTrainedModel"     
## [4] "torch.nn.modules.module.Module"                  
## [5] "transformers.modeling_utils.EmbeddingAccessMixin"
## [6] "transformers.modeling_utils.ModuleUtilsMixin"    
## [7] "transformers.utils.hub.PushToHubMixin"           
## [8] "transformers.integrations.peft.PeftAdapterMixin" 
## [9] "python.builtin.object"
```

--- 

```{r r.gliner 3}
#| eval: false 
assign("extract_entities", 
  extractor$extract_entities,
  envir = .GlobalEnv)

class(extract_entities)
args(extract_entities)

extraia_entidades <- extractor$extract_entities
class(extraia_entidades)
## [1] "python.builtin.method" "python.builtin.object"
args(extraia_entidades)
## function (text, entity_types, threshold = 0.5, format_results = TRUE, 
##     include_confidence = FALSE, include_spans = FALSE, max_len = NULL) 
## NULL
```
---

```{r }
#| eval: false
extraia_entidades("O grupo R Brasil no Telegram agora transmite vídeos", c("name"))
## $entities
## $entities$name
## [1] "grupo R Brasil" "Telegram"
```
